svg.text: Hand-picked earth tones (darker, warm hues kept rich, cool ones muted), then every color leans 10% toward the lime so
the set reads as one orchard.
Each ring is a Default color, each dot the palette's; the arrows are the moves between, in order:
HUE AND COLORFULNESS: angle is hue, distance out is chroma
⊕ lime: what every color leans toward
Earth-tone neutrals: a warm olive-brown dark, a cream light. Follows the accent's hue.
Each key's lightness against Default's ramp: ring Default, dot this palette (its fill is the key's own color, so a tint shows).
The ramp turns by the accent's OK hue minus green's, holding each key's luminance; a tint band scales its chroma by where it lands.
no tint band: full tint at every hue
chroma kept (of authored), by the OK hue the ground lands on; dots are the accents
tint band: center 85°, flat 10°, fall 50°, floor 0.45
chroma kept (of authored), by the OK hue the ground lands on; dots are the accents
